members.name: clear_traces
members.doc: Clear traces of memory blocks allocated by Python.

members.name: get_object_traceback
members.doc: Get the traceback where the Python object *obj* was allocated. Return a Traceback instance. Return None if the tracemalloc module is not tracing memory allocati

members.name: get_traceback_limit
members.doc: Get the maximum number of frames stored in the traceback of a trace. By default, a trace of an allocated memory block only stores the most recent frame: the lim

members.name: get_traced_memory
members.doc: Get the current size and peak size of memory blocks traced by tracemalloc. Returns a tuple: (current: int, peak: int).

members.name: get_tracemalloc_memory
members.doc: Get the memory usage in bytes of the tracemalloc module. This memory is used internally to trace memory allocations.

members.name: is_tracing
members.doc: Return True if the tracemalloc module is tracing Python memory allocations.

members.name: reset_peak
members.doc: Set the peak size of memory blocks traced by tracemalloc to the current size. Do nothing if the tracemalloc module is not tracing memory allocations.

members.name: Sequence
members.doc: All the operations on a read-only sequence. Concrete subclasses must override __new__ or __init__, __getitem__, and __len__.

members.name: Snapshot
members.doc: Snapshot of traces of memory blocks allocated by Python.

members.name: start
members.doc: Start tracing Python memory allocations. Also set the maximum number of frames stored in the traceback of a trace to nframe.

members.name: Statistic
members.doc: Statistic difference on memory allocations between two Snapshot instance.

members.name: StatisticDiff
members.doc: Statistic difference on memory allocations between an old and a new Snapshot instance.

members.name: stop
members.doc: Stop tracing Python memory allocations. Also clear traces of memory blocks allocated by Python.

members.name: take_snapshot
members.doc: Take a snapshot of traces of memory blocks allocated by Python.

members.name: total_ordering
members.doc: Class decorator that fills in missing ordering methods

members.name: Traceback
members.doc: Sequence of Frame instances sorted from the oldest frame to the most recent frame.
